title: Run time limit
intro: How long one agent run in this workspace may take before Thulu stops it and says so on the task. Without a value of its own the workspace gets the install's default.
read_only: Only a workspace admin can change the run time limit.

help: Install default: {default}. The most this workspace may choose: {ceiling}.
